statement: The system shall allow each team to manage its own budget independently.
The system shall allow the IFA to monitor team budgets and audit financial transactions.
The system shall enable the IFA to define budget policies and receive alerts for policy violations.
The system shall allow only team members to access their own financial data.
The system shall allow the IFA to view consolidated monetary information across all teams.
The system shall prevent the IFA from modifying team budget transactions.
The system shall allow referees to input game events in real time using a mobile application.
The system shall allow only the main referee and side referees to input game events.
The system shall make game-related data publicly accessible to unregistered guests.
The system shall allow users to export game data for external use such as by journalists or analysts.
The system shall allow team managers and administrators to view and analyze their team's internal data offline.
The system shall support the definition of scheduling policies for matches, including home and away games.
The system shall support constraints in scheduling such as minimum rest days between games based on the number of teams.
The system shall allow the IFA to define referee assignment policies, including avoiding repeated assignments between the same teams and referees.
The system shall allow referees to input their availability preferences, such as vacation periods, for scheduling consideration.
The system shall allow manual rescheduling of matches in exceptional circumstances such as weather disruptions.
The system shall allow IFA representatives to manually override automatic scheduling results.
The system shall require an IFA representative to provide a rationale when overriding automatic scheduling.
The system shall require a second IFA representative to confirm any manual scheduling changes.
The system shall support a single approval level for scheduling changes, with one IFA representative initiating and another confirming.
The system shall allow fans to register for push notifications about specific games, players, or events.
The system shall allow fans to follow teams and players and receive updates when new content is posted.
The system shall provide live score updates and in-game event notifications to subscribed fans.
The system shall ensure that only official referee inputs are the source of in-game event data.
The system shall provide a unified backend with different interfaces for teams, IFA administrators, referees, and fans.
The system shall provide a web-based interface for teams and IFA administrators.
The system shall provide a mobile application for referees and fans.
The system shall send automated reminders for policy compliance, such as budget reporting deadlines.
The system shall allow users to set personalized alerts, such as reminders before a game starts.
The system shall respond to user requests within two seconds for fans, teams, and IFA administrators.
The system shall prioritize referee inputs during live games to ensure real-time responsiveness.
The system shall support up to 50,000 concurrent users.
The system shall support localization including multiple languages, currencies, and time zones.
The system shall comply with local data regulations, including data residency requirements for specific countries.
The system shall encrypt budget data to prevent unauthorized access.
The system shall allow players to update their social network pages within the system to communicate with fans.
The system shall require user registration for full access, with guest access limited to public game data.
The system shall allow team managers or owners to request team registration with supporting documents, which the IFA can approve.
The system shall maintain archives of past seasons' schedules and game data.
The system shall allow the IFA to define leagues, seasons, and policies for budgeting, scheduling, and gameplay.
The system shall allow the IFA to register and appoint referees.
The system shall allow teams to register player information.
The system shall allow the IFA to audit player registration without direct input into the process.
